name: UltraGram 1.0.0.F2
body:
UltraGram 1.0.0.F2

Independent messenger ecosystem release.

## Included assets
- UltraGram-1.0.0.F2.apk - Android client (versionCode 10002)
- UltraGram Setup.exe - Windows installer (Electron)

## Android / backend connection fixes
- Backend binds 0.0.0.0:8787 and prints LAN + emulator addresses.
- Unified login by phone, email or username.
- Auth token persisted and injected as Bearer; 401 clears the session.
- Debug builds default to http://10.0.2.2:8787/ (Android emulator).
- Real phones use a configurable server address in Settings.
- Release builds are HTTPS-only (network_security_config + NetworkModule check).
- Fixed profile update 500 (undefined sql.js bindings).
- Chat list includes other_user profile.

## Version
- Version Name: 1.0.0.F2
- Version Code: 10002
- Package: com.ultragram.android

## Windows installer
- Size: 94729416 bytes (90.3 MB)
- SHA-256: 9A403ACBD0DBD17F759E8BBD89AA57B8F7F71D0B9FE0D470EABA82BBCD8EFB6B

## Administrators
Two ADMIN accounts exist in the backend database: ultragram_admin and Fyn8zrox2, both active with verification status Admin and roles ADMIN + Verified UltraGram. Passwords are not published.

## Notes
- Production HTTPS domain must be provided by the operator; the app lets the user enter it in Settings.
- The release APK default server URL is empty by design (no invented domain).
